songs.pasteHelp: Paste English in one box and Spanish in the other. Headers like “Verse 1 / Verso 1, Chorus / Coro, Bridge / Puente” are detected; without headers each paragraph becomes a section and repeated paragraphs become the chorus.
songs.filesHelp: Choose OpenLyrics (.xml from OpenLP, FreeShow…), ChordPro (.cho, .chordpro) or plain text (.txt) files. You can choose many at once.

bible.title: Bible

err.empty: Type a reference such as John 3:16.
err.numbers: Chapter/verse numbers not recognized. Try 3:16 or 3:16-18.
err.notFound: No verses found for that chapter/verse — check the numbers (e.g. Juan 3 has 36 verses).
err.missing: Not saved yet in this version.

bible.missingPasted_one: 1 verse is not saved in {{version}} yet.
bible.missingPasted_other: {{count}} verses are not saved in {{version}} yet.
bible.searchPlaceholder: Words to find, e.g. “love one another”
bible.searchHelp: Search works in any language and ignores accents.
bible.pasteIntro: Copyrighted Bibles such as La Biblia de las Américas can't be shipped inside a free app, but the publisher allows quoting up to 500 verses. Copy the week's passage from the site where you read it, paste it here, and ICCWorship saves it for every future service. The required credit line is added automatically.
bible.pasteHere: Paste the passage here (with verse numbers)
bible.notFound: Could not find verse number(s): {{list}}. Type them in below.
bible.overLimit: Careful: more than {{limit}} verses are stored. Ask the publisher for permission or delete old ones.
bible.usage: {{count}} of {{limit}} verses allowed without written permission
bible.nearLimit: Getting close to the limit — consider deleting verses you no longer need.
bible.pastedTitle: Use a copyrighted Bible (LBLA, NVI, RVR1960…)
bible.pastedExplain: Create a “paste-in” version. Each week, paste the verses you need; they are saved on this computer only and reused automatically. If the church later gets a licensed digital file, import it on the Versions tab and the limit goes away.
bible.createLbla: Set up La Biblia de las Américas (LBLA)
bible.confirmDelete: Delete “{{name}}” and all its saved verses?
bible.importHelp: For Bibles the church has the right to use: OSIS or USFX XML (for example from github.com/seven1m/open-bibles or the publisher) or ICCWorship JSON.

importErr.empty: No Bible text was found in that file. Use a complete OSIS or USFX XML Bible, or an ICCWorship JSON Bible.
importErr.unsupported: That file isn't a Bible format ICCWorship can read (OSIS, USFX or ICCWorship JSON).
importErr.id-taken: That abbreviation belongs to a built-in Bible. Choose another abbreviation.

media.title: Media
media.alreadyIn_one: 1 file was already in the library

media.confirmRemove: Remove it from ICCWorship? (The file itself is not deleted.)

media.dropHelp: MP4, MOV, WebM, JPG, PNG, MP3 and WAV work. Files stay where they are — nothing is copied.
media.empty: The media library is empty. Add files on the Media page.
media.noPresentations: No presentations yet. Import one on the Media page.
media.ppHelpOk: PowerPoint is installed: slides will look exactly like the original.
media.ppHelpLo: LibreOffice is installed: slides are converted to images with nearly the same look.
media.ppHelpNone: Neither PowerPoint nor LibreOffice is installed: the text of each slide is imported (install free LibreOffice for full slides, or save the PowerPoint as PDF).
media.animNote: Animations inside a slide are not kept.
media.dropPresTitle: Drag a PowerPoint or PDF here
media.dropPresHelp: Google Slides or Keynote? Download them as PDF first.
media.translateHelp: These slides were imported as text. Add the Spanish/English translation and they will show bilingually.

settings.title: Settings
settings.screensHelp: Choose which screen is the projector / TV. The projector window opens full-screen there.

settings.messagesHelp: Quick messages for the bottom of the screen. {n} is replaced with the number you type (for example the nursery number).
settings.remoteHelp: Any phone, tablet or computer on the church Wi-Fi can control the slides or show the stage display. Nothing goes to the internet.
settings.noNetwork: No network found. Connect this computer to the church Wi-Fi.
settings.firewall: The first time, Windows may ask to allow ICCWorship on the network — choose “Allow” for private networks.
settings.backupHelp: Everything (songs, plans, people, pasted verses, imported slides) goes in one .zip — save it to a USB drive. ICCWorship also makes an automatic backup every day.
settings.restoreConfirm: Restoring replaces current data (a safety copy is made first). Continue?
settings.restoreFailed: That file is not an ICCWorship backup.
settings.aboutText: Free and open-source church presentation software (MIT license). Made with love for churches that need it.
settings.credits: Bibles included: King James Version and Reina-Valera 1909 (public domain, via the open-bibles project).
settings.newPin: New PIN (disconnects phones and stage screens)
settings.portHelp: Press Enter to apply. Use a number from 1024 to 65535.

help.title: Keyboard shortcuts
help.note: Shortcuts work on every page, except while typing in a box. A presentation clicker (PageUp/PageDown) works too.
